messages.Searches the site and opens the results: Searches the site and opens the results page.
messages.Flux SEO builds /llms.txt from the site: Flux SEO builds /llms.txt from the site name, description, menu and recent content.
messages.Turn on the WebMCP search tool: Turn on the WebMCP search tool
messages.Adds toolname/tooldescription to the sea: Adds toolname/tooldescription to the search form so browser agents see it as a tool.
messages.X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, COOP same-o: X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, COOP same-origin-allow-popups and a basic CSP (object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'). Do not turn on if the site is embedded in other sites with an iframe.
messages.If every subdomain is HTTPS, HSTS also c: If every subdomain is HTTPS, HSTS also covers subdomains.
Turned on. Run the site audit again.
messages.The five PageSpeed Insights sections (Pe: The five PageSpeed Insights sections (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO, Agentic Browsing) by priority. The on-site audit needs no key and runs by itself every day; a PageSpeed run adds Google's real Lighthouse result.
messages.No PageSpeed run yet. Press \"Measure wi: No PageSpeed run yet. Press "Measure with PageSpeed" (mobile + desktop takes about 1 minute).
messages.Start the audit; recommendations are lis: Start the audit; recommendations are listed here by priority.
messages.Optional but recommended: the keyless qu: Optional but recommended: the keyless quota is shared and runs out quickly. In Google Cloud Console › APIs, enable "PageSpeed Insights API" and create a free key.
messages.Generate /llms.txt (site name, descripti: Generate /llms.txt (site name, description, menu pages, recent content)
messages.E.g. who your organization is, what it d: E.g. who your organization is, what it does, which pages agents should read first.
messages.WebMCP: expose the search form to browse: WebMCP: expose the search form to browser agents as a tool
messages.HSTS preload (takes months to undo; ever: HSTS preload (takes months to undo; every subdomain must be HTTPS)
messages.Rules and a checklist for SEO, performan: Rules and a checklist for SEO, performance, accessibility, security and agent readiness when you build a new page, theme or preset. AI agents get the same guide with the MCP tool flxseo_site_build_guide, and Flux AI chat gets it as a tool.
messages.Turned on and the audit was refreshed. I: Turned on and the audit was refreshed. If a page cache (LiteSpeed) is on, run Purge All.
messages.Home page does not return a successful s: Home page does not return a successful status code
messages.The page must return 200. It may be main: The page must return 200. It may be maintenance mode, a redirect loop or a PHP error; check System Check and the error log.
messages.Page is blocked from search engines: Page is blocked from search engines
messages.Untick Settings › Reading › \"Discourage: Untick Settings › Reading › "Discourage search engines from indexing this site" and turn off noindex in the page's own SEO panel.
messages.The robots.txt file in the site root mus: The robots.txt file in the site root must not have "Disallow: /" under "User-agent: *". Delete or fix the file; WordPress generates its own robots.txt.
messages.The theme must declare add_theme_support: The theme must declare add_theme_support( 'title-tag' ); fill in the home title in SEO › General.
messages.Keep the title around 60 characters; Goo: Keep the title around 60 characters; Google cuts the rest.
messages.Turn on SEO output and write the home de: Turn on SEO output and write the home description (150–160 characters).
messages.Each page needs exactly one rel=canonica: Each page needs exactly one rel=canonical. If another plugin or the theme also adds one, turn one off.
messages.No hreflang on a multilingual site: No hreflang on a multilingual site
messages.With Flux Lang active, language versions: With Flux Lang active, language versions must be linked with hreflang; check the language pairs in Flux Lang settings.
messages.Each page needs one H1 that names the to: Each page needs one H1 that names the topic; subheadings are H2/H3.
messages.With Flux SEO output on, Organization, W: With Flux SEO output on, Organization, WebSite and Breadcrumb schema are added. Find the block or plugin that outputs broken JSON-LD.
messages.Write text that names the target instead: Write text that names the target instead of "click here", "more", "here" (e.g. "See donation options").
messages.More than one post with the same title: More than one post with the same title
messages.Delete the duplicate (usually the addres: Delete the duplicate (usually the address ending in -2) or redirect it to the original; give different titles if both are needed. When links with the same text go to different addresses, the "Identical links have the same purpose" audit also fails.
messages.WordPress version is visible on the page: WordPress version is visible on the page
messages.The meta generator tag reveals the versi: The meta generator tag reveals the version. The theme should call remove_action( 'wp_head', 'wp_generator' ); Flux SEO removes it when security headers are on.
messages.Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scal: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1 from the viewport tag: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">. Users with low vision cannot zoom; the Accessibility score drops directly.
messages.The theme must add <meta name=\"viewport: The theme must add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to <head>; otherwise the page opens at desktop width on mobile.
messages.ARIA role is missing required children: ARIA role is missing required children
messages.E.g. role=\"tablist\" may only contain r: E.g. role="tablist" may only contain role="tab" elements. Use <div role="tablist"><button role="tab"> instead of <ol role="tablist"><li><button role="tab">, or give the li elements role="presentation". The accessibility tree breaks and Lighthouse also lowers the Agentic Browsing score.
messages.ARIA role is not inside its required par: ARIA role is not inside its required parent
messages.role=\"tab\" must sit directly inside ro: role="tab" must sit directly inside role="tablist", role="option" inside role="listbox". Remove the li/div elements in between or give them role="presentation".
messages.List items (<li>) are not inside a list: List items (<li>) are not inside a list
messages.<li> may only sit inside <ul>, <ol> or <: <li> may only sit inside <ul>, <ol> or <menu>, and the parent list must not get a non-list role (e.g. <ol role="tablist">).
messages.Give every meaningful image alt text tha: Give every meaningful image alt text that describes it; decorative images get alt="". Fill in alt text in the media library or turn on SEO › General › Images.
messages.Add aria-label or hidden text (screen-re: Add aria-label or hidden text (screen-reader-text) to icon-only links.
messages.Give icon buttons an aria-label (e.g. \": Give icon buttons an aria-label (e.g. "Open menu"). Agents and screen readers cannot tell what the button does.
messages.Each field needs a name through <label f: Each field needs a name through <label for> or aria-label; a placeholder is not a label.
messages.No id may be used twice; aria-controls,: No id may be used twice; aria-controls, aria-labelledby and label for must point to an existing id.
messages.Headings should step down in order (H2 →: Headings should step down in order (H2 → H3); do not skip levels for looks, size them with CSS.
messages.Values like tabindex=\"1\" break keyboar: Values like tabindex="1" break keyboard order; use 0 or -1.
messages.Links with the same text go to different: Links with the same text go to different addresses
messages.Links with the same name should go to th: Links with the same name should go to the same page. Remove the duplicate page or make the link texts different.
messages.Main content must be inside <main>; scre: Main content must be inside <main>; screen readers and agents find the main content this way.
messages.At least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 f: At least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. Darken the pale colors in the theme palette.
messages.Inline the critical CSS for the first sc: Inline the critical CSS for the first screen, load the rest with media="print" onload or at the end of the page, and defer JS. LiteSpeed Cache › Page Optimization › CSS/JS settings, or the theme's own combined CSS.
messages.Split the one large CSS file by page typ: Split the one large CSS file by page type, or drop unused rules (LiteSpeed "Remove Unused CSS"). The gain usually shows up in LCP.
messages.Ship .min versions of theme/plugin JS or: Ship .min versions of theme/plugin JS or turn on LiteSpeed "JS Minify".
messages.Minify CSS (LiteSpeed \"CSS Minify\" or: Minify CSS (LiteSpeed "CSS Minify" or a build step).
messages.Animate with transform and opacity; prop: Animate with transform and opacity; properties like stroke-dashoffset, top/left and width repaint on every frame. Stop them under prefers-reduced-motion.
messages.Aim for under 1,500 elements. Reduce cop: Aim for under 1,500 elements. Reduce copies in marquees, build hidden menus and long lists on demand, simplify nested wrappers.
messages.If the LCP element is text, preload its: If the LCP element is text, preload its font, use font-display: swap and do not hide it behind an entrance animation on the first frame; if it is an image, give it fetchpriority="high" and do not lazy load it.
messages.Give images width/height and late blocks: Give images width/height and late blocks a fixed height; use size-adjust/fallback metrics for web fonts; absolutely positioned animated layers must not push the layout.
messages.Use font-display: swap in @font-face, pr: Use font-display: swap in @font-face, preload the 1-2 fonts used on the first screen with <link rel="preload" as="font" crossorigin>, remove unused weights.
messages.Fonts loaded from CSS lengthen the chain: Fonts loaded from CSS lengthen the chain; preload first-screen fonts and defer unneeded requests in the chain (e.g. guest.vary.php).
messages.Do not read offsetWidth/getBoundingClien: Do not read offsetWidth/getBoundingClientRect after changing styles in JS; read first, then write inside requestAnimationFrame.
messages.Split JS that runs at startup and defer: Split JS that runs at startup and defer work for off-screen sections with IntersectionObserver.
messages.Images are large or in an old format: Images are large or in an old format
messages.Use WebP/AVIF, never send images larger: Use WebP/AVIF, never send images larger than displayed (srcset), turn on image compression.
messages.Give <img> tags width and height; the br: Give tags width and height; the browser reserves space and the page does not shift.
messages.Do not give the page's first image loadi: Do not give the page's first image loading="lazy"; give it fetchpriority="high". If LiteSpeed lazy load is on, exclude the first image (data-no-lazy or "Lazy Load Image Excludes").
messages.Turn on page cache (LiteSpeed Cache); ch: Turn on page cache (LiteSpeed Cache); check slow plugins and the cron report in Flux Speed.
messages.Turn on gzip or brotli on the server (on: Turn on gzip or brotli on the server (on by default on Hostinger/LiteSpeed; check the CDN settings).
messages.Move inline SVG icons into a sprite and: Move inline SVG icons into a sprite and large inline CSS/JSON into files.
messages.Modern browsers draw emoji themselves; t: Modern browsers draw emoji themselves; the theme can remove print_emoji_detection_script.
messages.Target under 2.5 s. Reduce render-blocki: Target under 2.5 s. Reduce render-blocking CSS, preload the LCP font/image, turn on the server cache.
messages.Target under 0.1. Size images, prevent f: Target under 0.1. Size images, prevent font shifts, reserve space for elements added later.
messages.Target under 200 ms. Reduce startup JS a: Target under 200 ms. Reduce startup JS and defer third-party scripts.
messages.Target under 1.8 s. Reduce render-blocki: Target under 1.8 s. Reduce render-blocking CSS/JS and server response time.
messages.Prioritize critical CSS and fonts so the: Prioritize critical CSS and fonts so the first screen fills quickly; shorten entrance animations.
messages.Site is not HTTPS or has mixed content: Site is not HTTPS or has mixed content
messages.Set the addresses to https:// in Setting: Set the addresses to https:// in Settings › General and fix images/scripts loaded over http://.
messages.Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains. If every subdomain is HTTPS, you can also add "preload" and submit to hstspreload.org.
messages.No or incomplete Content Security Policy: No or incomplete Content Security Policy (CSP)
messages.Flux SEO can add a basic CSP (object-src: Flux SEO can add a basic CSP (object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'). A full script-src policy can break plugins on WordPress; try Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only first.
messages.Send X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and CSP: Send X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and CSP frame-ancestors 'self'. Do not turn on if your site is embedded in other sites with an iframe.
messages.Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-or: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups; payment and login popups keep working.
messages.Advanced protection against DOM-based XS: Advanced protection against DOM-based XSS. Most WordPress plugins are not compatible yet; try it with Report-Only only on custom-theme sites with few plugins.
messages.X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Flux SE: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Flux SEO sends it by default; the server or a cache plugin may be removing it.
messages.The page must start with <!DOCTYPE html>: The page must start with <!DOCTYPE html> and have <meta charset="UTF-8"> in the first lines.
messages.AI agents summarize a site through /llms: AI agents summarize a site through /llms.txt. Flux SEO builds it from the site name, description, menu pages and recent content; one click to turn it on.
messages.llms.txt is not in the recommended forma: llms.txt is not in the recommended format
messages.The first line must be \"# Site name\",: The first line must be "# Site name", then "> short summary" and link lists in [title](url) form. If an old hand-made file sits in the root, delete it; Flux SEO generates one.
messages.Forms are not declared as WebMCP tools: Forms are not declared as WebMCP tools
messages.WebMCP lets browser agents call forms as: WebMCP lets browser agents call forms as tools (form toolname/tooldescription). Flux SEO adds it to the search form; add it to your own forms too.
messages.If crawlers like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Goog: If crawlers like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot are blocked, your content does not show up in AI answers. Remove them from robots.txt unless you block them on purpose.
messages.%d render-blocking CSS/JS requests in <h: %d render-blocking CSS/JS requests in <head>. Measure the estimated saving with PageSpeed.
messages.Response measured from the server: %d ms: Response measured from the server: %d ms (may bypass the cache).
messages.The HTTPS page loads content over http:/: The HTTPS page loads content over http://.
messages.PageSpeed Insights can only measure addr: PageSpeed Insights can only measure addresses reachable from the internet.
messages.The PageSpeed daily quota is used up. En: The PageSpeed daily quota is used up. Enter a free Google API key in SEO › Settings.
messages.Not run yet. Check performance, accessib: Not run yet. Check performance, accessibility, SEO, security and agent readiness.
messages.Another SEO plugin is active; meta, Open: Another SEO plugin is active; meta, Open Graph and schema come from it. Flux SEO turned its own output off to avoid conflicts.
messages.Meta description, Open Graph and schema: Meta description, Open Graph and schema are added to every page.
messages.Off. Page descriptions, images and organ: Off. Page descriptions, images and organization details will not show on Google and social shares. Turn it on if you want to be found on Google.
messages.The automatic site audit found new recom: The automatic site audit found new recommendations:
messages.No reports yet. Every audit (manual, aut: No reports yet. Every audit (manual, automatic or by AI) is saved here.
messages.Runs in the background and saves the res: Runs in the background and saves the result to Report history. The time uses the site time zone; if the site gets no visit at that time, it starts on the next request.
messages.Also run PageSpeed Insights (mobile + de: Also run PageSpeed Insights (mobile + desktop; needs the API key)
messages.Send an email when a new critical or hig: Send an email when a new critical or high priority recommendation appears
messages.The five PageSpeed Insights sections (Pe: The five PageSpeed Insights sections (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO, Agentic Browsing) by priority. The on-site audit needs no key; a PageSpeed run adds Google's real Lighthouse result. Automatic audit, API key and security headers are in the Settings tab.
messages.No report with a PageSpeed run yet. Ente: No report with a PageSpeed run yet. Enter the API key and turn on PageSpeed in the automatic audit.
messages.Flux SEO's AI (MCP) tools run through th: Flux SEO's AI (MCP) tools run through the shared MCP server. The server, keys and settings are in Flux AI & MCP › MCP; install and activate Flux AI 0.7.0 or later.
messages.IndexNow is off or the site is hidden fr: IndexNow is off or the site is hidden from search engines (Settings › Reading).
messages.%d URLs submitted to Bing, Yandex and th: %d URLs submitted to Bing, Yandex and the other IndexNow search engines.
messages.Add property › URL prefix › HTML tag. Le: Add property › URL prefix › HTML tag. Leave empty if you verified with DNS.
messages.The easiest path is \"Import from Google: The easiest path is "Import from Google Search Console": verification and the sitemap arrive on their own, no code. If you add it by hand, paste the HTML meta tag. DuckDuckGo, Yahoo and Ecosia results come from Bing.
messages.Add site › Meta tag. After verifying, ad: Add site › Meta tag. After verifying, add the sitemap URL under Indexing › Sitemap files.
messages.key file could not be verified: key file could not be verified
messages.URLs do not match the site domain: URLs do not match the site domain
messages.too many requests, try again later: too many requests, try again later
messages.Search engines other than Google (Bing,: Search engines other than Google (Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, Ecosia) crawl a site quickly only once it is introduced to them. Add the site in each one's webmaster panel, paste the verification code below and submit the sitemap URL.
messages.Also listed in robots.txt; add this URL: Also listed in robots.txt; add this URL in Search Console, Bing and Yandex.
messages.Verification tag is on the site: Verification tag is on the site
messages.Instantly notify Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckG: Instantly notify Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckGo (via Bing), Seznam and Naver about published and updated pages
messages.When on, the whole site is submitted onc: When on, the whole site is submitted once automatically. Google does not use IndexNow; add your sitemap in Search Console for Google.
messages.The site is hidden from search engines (: The site is hidden from search engines (Settings › Reading); IndexNow sends nothing.
messages.robots.txt blocks the Bing or Yandex cra: robots.txt blocks the Bing or Yandex crawler
messages.Search crawlers such as Bingbot, YandexB: Search crawlers such as Bingbot, YandexBot and DuckDuckBot must not have "Disallow: /"; otherwise the site only appears on Google. Fix the robots.txt file in the site root.
messages.Bing and Yandex find the sitemap from th: Bing and Yandex find the sitemap from the "Sitemap:" line in robots.txt. If a hand-written robots.txt sits in the root, delete it (Flux SEO adds the line) or add the line yourself.
messages.IndexNow instantly notifies Bing, Yandex: IndexNow instantly notifies Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver about new and updated pages; it is the fastest way to show up outside Google. One click to turn it on.
messages.The key file (/<key>.txt) must be reacha: The key file (/<key>.txt) must be reachable from outside. If a cache or security plugin blocks it, add an exception, then use SEO › General › IndexNow › "Submit the whole site now".
messages.The site may not be added to Bing Webmas: The site may not be added to Bing Webmaster Tools and Yandex Webmaster; without that it appears late or not at all there. On Bing, "Import from Google Search Console" needs no code; ignore this if you already imported. The codes are under SEO › General › Search engines.
messages.New and updated pages are sent instantly: New and updated pages are sent instantly to Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver; the whole site is submitted once automatically.
messages.No verification code: %s. Add the site i: No verification code: %s. Add the site in these search engines' webmaster panels (Bing's import from Google Search Console needs no code).
messages.Bing and Yandex verification codes are s: Bing and Yandex verification codes are set.
messages.On; the site has been submitted to Bing: On; the site has been submitted to Bing and Yandex.
messages.On; the first bulk submission is sent on: On; the first bulk submission is sent on the next admin page load.
messages.Off; new pages are not sent to Bing and: Off; new pages are not sent to Bing and Yandex.
messages.Korea's largest search engine. Add site: Korea's largest search engine. Add site › HTML tag; then Request › Submit sitemap. Optional.
messages.Czech search engine (Webmaster link at t: Czech search engine (Webmaster link at the bottom of the page). Meta tag method. Optional.
messages.China's search engine; sign-up may need: China's search engine; sign-up may need a Chinese phone number. Not needed unless you target China.
messages.Connected with Google Site Kit; Search C: Connected with Google Site Kit; Search Console verification and the sitemap are handled there. You can leave this empty.
messages.Topics the organization is an expert in: Topics the organization is an expert in (schema knowsAbout). Search engines and AI assistants match the organization to these topics. Left out when empty.
messages.Country served (schema areaServed). Left: Country served (schema areaServed). Left out when empty.
messages.For organizations that accept donations: For organizations that accept donations (schema DonateAction). Left out when the label is empty; when the URL is empty the donation page is found automatically.
messages.Findings show up here after an audit run: Findings show up here after an audit runs.
messages.PHP %1$s is not patched against %2$s. Up: PHP %1$s is not patched against %2$s. Update to at least %3$s (hosting panel › PHP version). A distribution package may carry the fix without changing the version number; ask your provider if unsure.
messages.PHP %1$s no longer gets security fixes;: PHP %1$s no longer gets security fixes; holes such as %2$s stay open. Move to PHP %3$s or another patched, newer version.
messages.session.upload_progress.enabled is on. W: session.upload_progress.enabled is on. WordPress does not use it; turning it off shrinks the attack surface. Set "session.upload_progress.enabled = Off" in php.ini or the hosting panel.
messages.PHP version is missing a security patch: PHP version is missing a security patch
messages.The server's PHP is unpatched against a: The server's PHP is unpatched against a known hole or no longer supported. Upgrade PHP to the current patch release from the hosting panel.
messages.WordPress does not use this PHP feature;: WordPress does not use this PHP feature; it is the exploit path for holes such as PHP2Shell. Set session.upload_progress.enabled = Off in php.ini or the hosting panel.
messages.Meta title/description, canonical, Open: Meta title/description, canonical, Open Graph, schema (Organization, WebSite, Breadcrumb, Article), sitemap settings, favicon and SEO control. Content and SEO tools for AI assistants (on MCP server Flux AI).
messages.PageSpeed timed out; this step was skipp: PageSpeed timed out; this step was skipped.
